subject: Lexy / Linx internal test — are you interested?
body:
Hi,

This is Lexy’s controlled Linx internal test—not a real job opportunity or hiring decision.
We are testing the order: interest-check email, your Interested response, then a separately approved interview invitation.
There is no interview link in this message and no invitation will be sent automatically.

--- AI-generated draft being tested ---
Hi Synthetic Evidence,

I came across your impressive background as a SQL backend engineer and thought you might be interested in a unique opportunity with Disposable evidence UI. The role of [AUTONOMY PILOT] Synthetic SQL backend engineer is a perfect match for your skills in SQL, PostgreSQL, and API design. This position focuses on isolated fictional backend engineering, allowing you to dive deep into the technical aspects without the need for candidate contact or automatic pipeline execution.

Your expertise in automated testing would be a great asset to the team, and this role could be a strong next step in your career. Would you be open to a quick chat this week?

Please use the Interested button if you want to continue this internal test.
Lexy
